claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Unarmored Defense is always-on with no activation step, no use count, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires activationCost/resource/resetCadence — none of which apply here. A 'passive' (or 'inherent') family is needed to represent features that apply persistently without being used.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_base_ac_formula effect for ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature replaces the creature's base AC with a formula referencing two named ability modifiers (DEX + WIS) rather than applying a flat delta. No existing ClassFeatureEffect (grant_extra_action, heal_hp) or ReactionEffect (modify_ac with flat delta) can express this. A new effect variant is needed that takes a base integer and a list of ability modifiers to sum.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers

claude_proposed_widenings.name: equipment_condition predicate for passive features
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The AC formula only applies when the monk is not wearing armor and not wielding a Shield. This 'while not equipped with X' conditional has no surface representation. A predicate type is needed to gate passive effects on equipment state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield
